# Sourdough vs regular bread

Fermentation does reduce fructans (https://gutstudies.org/sourdough-fermentation-digestion), but a well-known Stanford digestion study found no difference in most people (https://bread-truth.institute/definitive-study).

Verdict: mildly easier for some, mostly marketing for the rest.
